_doc: Known defects of the written-answer coach, each pointing at the labelled cases that show it. Cases stay in their original sets (their membership and hashes don't change); this file only groups them so a fix can be checked against every case that showed the defect. status: open (the defect still shows on these cases) or fixed (with the commit and rubric version). docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL.md. signal: the check (and, for points, the rubric point) whose failure is this defect.

defects.found: 2026-11-03, measuring rubric v2 on the (now exposed) held-out set
defects.summary: An unpunctuated dictated answer is rated below its labels: scene, preparation and actions are missed.
Actions told with ordinary verbs (I sat down, I arranged, I booked) don't count towards 'Describes specific actions you took'.
Lists of rubric words with no account of anything done are rated Good or Strong.
An answer that takes back what it said keeps the credit for it.
Generic answers get credit for 'strengths' and 'role' points without a specific reason or example.
Text addressed to the grader earned points and was quoted as evidence.
